title: Redux Toolkit
description: Learn the modern, official way to write Redux logic.
longDescription: Redux Toolkit is the official, opinionated toolset for efficient Redux development. In this module you'll learn to configure a store with configureStore, create slices with createSlice, and handle async logic with createAsyncThunk. You'll see how Redux Toolkit eliminates most Redux boilerplate while maintaining the same predictable state container.
whatYouLearn: Set up a store with configureStore
